name: Admin Accounting Hosting Cycle Payments
description: Superuser registers hosting cycle payments from the row menu's 'Ciclos de pago' entry at /panel/accounting/hostings: the modal shows immutable historical modality/amount snapshots and a register form offering quarterly, semiannual and every-9-month cycles. It is prefilled from the current contract (amount = payment_per_cycle, modality, paid_at = today) with an 'Extender vigencia' toggle. total_paid/cycles_count recompute from history; deleting a cycle recalculates but never rolls back valid_to.
